verdict.rationale: Exporting chat history and account data is a fair trust-control question for a consumer AI assistant like Kimi, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a data-export or chat-history download feature. The help-center topics, the API file uploads and the Admin API's billing, usage and audit-log queries are different capabilities and do not count as personal chat or account export.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can export my complete chat history and account data
